highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.1 brings two upstream correctness fixes to the m150 engine.
highlights_body: It fixes corrupt serialized text handling and stencil-area validation for clipped render passes.

bullets.lead: Corrupt serialized text is handled safely
bullets.detail: Corrects destruction ordering in the GPU text allocator to prevent use-after-free and double-free behavior when a corrupt Slug buffer is rejected.

bullets.lead: Clipped render-pass stencil bounds are validated
bullets.detail: Includes the upstream m150 fix that checks clipped render-pass bounds against the cleared stencil area.

harfbuzz_summary: Ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.1 alongside the SkiaSharp 4.150.1 servicing release.
